title: VaultManifest
description: Local credential presence manifest (owned by R4, consumed by R5). Only indicates whether sensitive data is present in client vault, NEVER transmits values.

has_email.description: Whether user email is stored in local vault

has_password.description: Whether a password for current domain is stored in local vault

has_phone.description: Whether user phone number is stored in local vault

has_address.description: Whether user delivery address is stored in local vault

has_pan.description: Whether user PAN card identifier is stored in local vault

has_aadhaar.description: Whether user Aadhaar number is stored in local vault

has_card.description: Whether payment card information is stored in local vault
